document.title: Security audit 2026-11-07 (11): on-top question dialog and terminal refocus in verify-windows.ps1

acknowledgments.summary: audit of pull request test/windows-verify before merge, directed by the maintainer

notes.title: Summary
notes.text: Audit of the change that asks the context bar question in a Yes/No dialog kept on top of OBS, instead of in the terminal hidden behind OBS, and brings the PowerShell window back to the front after OBS closes. No security issues found.

notes.title: Audit details
notes.text: The dialog is a standard System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox owned by an invisible, off-screen TopMost form that is disposed in a finally block; only its Yes/No result is used. The text is fixed in the script. Refocusing uses WScript.Shell AppActivate with the script's own process ID, inside try/catch so a failure is ignored, plus a console bell. Neither call reads or sends data, starts other programs, or changes system settings.

notes.title: Result
notes.text: No findings. Logged as required by the project's audit policy.
